title: pouteria dominicensis
intro: Pouteria dominicensis, commonly known as the West Indian Mahogany or Bay Mahogany, is a plant species native to the Caribbean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria dominicensis may be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
